result.description:
An exciting career opportunity has become available for an experienced Perioperative Nurse to join a leading private hospital in Merewether as a Clinical Nurse Specialist – Floor Coordinator. This full-time or permanent part-time position is ideal for a dedicated professional ready to provide clinical leadership and drive operational efficiency within a dynamic Operating Theatre department. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in coordinating patient flow, supporting the clinical team, and ensuring that all services consistently meet high standards of safety, best clinical practice, and departmental excellence. 

 To be successful in this role, the candidate must hold current AHPRA registration and possess a minimum of 5 years of perioperative nursing experience. Applicants are expected to demonstrate strong leadership, mentoring, and organizational skills, along with a deep understanding of ACORN standards, ASNZ5369, and relevant NSW Health Policy Directives. While previous experience in nursing leadership, management, or relieving in Nursing Unit Manager roles is highly desirable, the core requirement is a commitment to patient-centered care and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced clinical environment. 

 Located in Merewether, this facility offers an exceptional work-life balance, positioned perfectly between the vibrant cafes and shops of The Junction and the renowned surfing waves of Merewether Beach. As Newcastle’s largest private hospital, the site provides a collaborative and innovative environment, supported by a comprehensive health precinct that includes ICU, surgical and cardiac wards, and a dedicated day surgery centre. The hospital is deeply committed to the growth and development of its staff, providing ongoing training, supported postgraduate education, and various wellbeing initiatives, including discounted private health insurance and paid parental leave. 

 This position is classified under the relevant Enterprise Agreement 2022, offering a competitive salary and benefits package commensurate with experience. Applications for this role are strictly open until 31 March 2026. Professionals interested in taking this next step in their perioperative career are encouraged to reach out for further details regarding the application process.   Apply Now

  Casual Role  
  Salary packaging opportunities up to $31,800 per year  
 
  About Us:  At RSL LifeCare, our Residential Care teams have the ability to make a big difference to the lives of veterans and seniors while they receive quality and compassionate care in our aged care homes. This is an opportunity for you to join a large social purpose organisation where you can have a huge positive impact and feel the personal and professional reward in return. At our core, RSL LifeCare provide care and services to veterans and seniors who live in our communities or who are receiving support at home. Our vision of creating proud communities living their best lives is at the heart of everything we do as we continue to build upon our legacy of supporting veterans and their families for more than 100 years.   About the role:  As a Recreation and Engagement Assistant at RSL LifeCare, every day you're empowered to make a meaningful difference to people's lives. Within our supportive work environment your skills and compassion are valued. You will have the opportunity to: 
 
 Support the goals of care for the residents in the service in partnership with each resident and/or their representative 
 Identify barriers that prevent consumers from participating in meaningful and enjoyable activities 
 Encourage the wellbeing and independence of residents by supporting them to engage in preferred activities and interests 
 Embody a person-centred approach, recognising and promoting the individual's unique goals and preferences 
 Participate in risk management and continuous quality improvement activities 
 Build strong and productive relationships with your team to deliver positive outcomes for residents 
 
  About you  
 
 A fantastic outlook on life with a fun personality! 
 Experience working in Lifestyle/Recreational Activities teams in Aged care/Disability/Community services  desirable  
 Cert IV in Leisure and Health and/ or relevant tertiary degree  preferable  
 A sound understanding of aged care and the principles guiding this sector 
 General computer skills 
 Australian work rights 
 
  ?It is a mandatory requirement for a team member working in the Aged Care sector to have a valid RSL LifeCare Police Check or a valid National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) check, or potentially both, to undertake the inherent requirements of the role.    Our commitment to diversity  We welcome and encourage applications from people across our diverse community, especially from Veterans, current serving ADF personnel, their families and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants. We believe everyone has the right to feel safe, respected, valued and heard regardless of their gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity or disability.
